cleared_behavior: The unchanged prior scoped_decline_preserves_application_escape_fallback test now passes.
The new nested_scoped_decline_reaches_outer_and_stops test passes: a declined inner scope reaches a consuming outer scope and does not reach App::on_esc.
Nested block bounds, actual second detail descendant Escape, resize-before-input and precise summary-allocation tests remain green.

The diagnostic enum extension is additive on a non_exhaustive enum and carries only stable IDs, with no field or secret values. Cx::diagnostic appends to the existing bounded Diagnostics store and cannot clear another component diagnostics. Its native cap64/drop6 test is green.

findings.problem: Eligible scoped bindings are collected before any callback runs, then all tuples are dispatched without revalidating current focus and top layer. An inner binding can open a modal and decline, after which an outer page binding still receives the same key under the new modal.
findings.observed: Outer scope callback runs once; expected zero after the modal becomes the active layer.
findings.required_fix: Revalidate actual current focused registration, active layer, scope membership and current candidate identity before every fallback dispatch. Stop or skip stale candidates using the existing router; do not trust the initial vector after callback effects. Add equivalent sibling-focus transition coverage and preserve the already green decline/outer/global ordering tests.

findings.problem: Ui::diagnostic is documented as bounded but appends directly to FrameState.diagnostics, which is Vec<Diagnostic>. It can accumulate an unbounded number of author diagnostics before commit. The bounded store is only reached later during frame commit. The new cap/drop test covers Cx only, not Ui.
findings.required_fix: Bound pending author diagnostics during draw using the existing Diagnostics store semantics or an equivalent narrow frame-owned cap/drop mechanism, transfer drop counts during frame commit, and reset pending counts each frame. Add a draw-side regression that emits70, verifies only64 retained with6 dropped, and proves other diagnostics are not erased. Do not add an error framework or expose mutable access that clears global diagnostics.

preserved_reference_note: The old summary_rows_reserves_requested_clamped_height test is preserved and still fails7vs8 because CodeEditor registers its body excluding one footer row. A separate source-based test verifies summary y9 and body7 plus footer1 equals8. See master-detail-review-b460.json; no reference output was silently rewritten.
